"""B1 ENTRY-only course fit from prior valid history. No evaluation labels."""
import json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
import duckdb
B=Path(__file__).parent; threads=int(sys.argv[1]); mode=sys.argv[2]
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
audit=json.loads((B/'input_audit.json').read_text());cfg=json.loads((B/'run_config.json').read_text())
for n in ['entry','history']:assert sha(B/(n+'.parquet'))==audit[n+'_sha256']
c=duckdb.connect();c.execute(f'set threads={threads}');c.execute("set memory_limit='1300MB'");c.execute('set preserve_insertion_order=false')
T='runner_id,race_id,race_date,venue,horse_key,horse_no,surface,distance_m,field_size,ambiguous,direction,band'.split(',')
H='runner_id,race_date,venue,horse_key,surface,distance_m,direction,band,perf'.split(',')
for n,f,cols in [('e','entry',T),('h','history',H)]:
 c.execute(f"create view {n} as select {','.join(cols)} from read_parquet('{B/(f+'.parquet')}')")
def gate(t,h):
 assert [x[0] for x in c.execute('describe '+t).fetchall()]==T
 assert [x[0] for x in c.execute('describe '+h).fetchall()]==H
dims=cfg['b1']['dimensions'];wins=cfg['b1']['windows']
def query(t,h):
 gate(t,h)
 agg=[];lists=[]
 for w in wins:
  lists.append(f'list_filter(l,lambda x: x.dd<={w}) l{w}')
  agg.extend([f'length(l{w}) n{w}',f'list_avg(list_transform(l{w},lambda x: x.p)) p{w}',f'list_max(list_transform(l{w},lambda x:x.d)) max{w}'])
  for k in dims:
   cond=f'list_filter(l{w},lambda x:x.{k})'
   agg.extend([f'length({cond}) n_{k}{w}',f'list_avg(list_transform({cond},lambda x:x.p))-list_avg(list_transform(l{w},lambda x:x.p)) d_{k}{w}',f'list_max(list_transform({cond},lambda x:x.d)) max_{k}{w}'])
 return f"""with j as (select t.runner_id,coalesce(list(struct_pack(p:=h.perf,d:=h.race_date,dd:=date_diff('day',h.race_date,t.race_date),venue:=h.venue=t.venue,band:=h.band=t.band,exact:=h.venue=t.venue and h.distance_m=t.distance_m and h.surface=t.surface,direction:=h.direction=t.direction and nullif(t.direction,'') is not null,dist:=h.distance_m,samevenue:=h.venue=t.venue) order by h.race_date desc,h.runner_id) filter(where h.runner_id is not null),[]) l from {t} t left join {h} h on not t.ambiguous and h.horse_key=t.horse_key and h.race_date<t.race_date and h.race_date>=t.race_date-interval '365 days' group by t.runner_id),a as(select *,{','.join(lists)} from j),b as(select runner_id,{','.join(agg)},(list_extract(l,1)).dist last_distance,(list_extract(l,1)).samevenue last_same_venue from a) select t.*,b.* exclude(runner_id) from {t} t join b using(runner_id)"""
def check(t):
 assert c.execute(f'select count(*) from {t} where '+' or '.join(f'{k}>=race_date' for k in [f'max{w}' for w in wins]+[f'max_{d}{w}' for w in wins for d in dims])).fetchone()[0]==0
def diff(a,b):
 cols=c.execute('describe '+a).fetchall()
 clauses=[f'((a.{k} is null)<>(b.{k} is null) or abs(a.{k}-b.{k})>1e-12)' if typ=='DOUBLE' else f'a.{k} is distinct from b.{k}' for k,typ,*_ in cols]
 return c.execute(f'select count(*) from {a} a full join {b} b using(runner_id) where a.runner_id is null or b.runner_id is null or '+' or '.join(clauses)).fetchone()[0]
checks=[]
for y in range(2023,2026):
 c.execute(f'create or replace temp view t as select * from e where year(race_date)={y}')
 c.execute(f'create or replace temp view hy as select * from h where year(race_date) between {y-1} and {y}')
 if mode=='full':
  c.execute('create or replace temp table f as '+query('t','hy'));check('f')
  p=B/f'b1_{y}_t{threads}.parquet';c.execute(f"copy (select * from f order by runner_id) to '{p}' (format parquet,compression zstd)")
  print(y,threads,sha(p),flush=True)
 else:
  d=c.execute('select min(race_date) from t').fetchone()[0];c.execute(f"create or replace temp view tt as select * from t where race_date=date '{d}'")
  c.execute(f"create or replace temp view hp as select * from hy where race_date<date '{d}'")
  c.execute("create or replace temp view hx as select * from hy union all select runner_id,race_date,venue,horse_key,surface,distance_m,direction,band,9999. from tt union all select runner_id,race_date+1,venue,horse_key,surface,distance_m,direction,band,-9999. from tt")
  for n,h in [('p','hp'),('q','hy'),('z','hx')]:
   c.execute(f'create or replace temp table {n} as '+query('tt',h));check(n)
  a,b=diff('p','q'),diff('p','z');assert a==b==0;checks.append({'year':y,'targets':c.execute('select count(*) from tt').fetchone()[0],'prefix':a,'injected':b})
if mode=='guard':
 for col in ['finish_position','popularity','status','body_weight_kg','payout_yen','overall_record_raw','track_condition']:
  c.execute(f'create or replace temp view bad as select *,0 as {col} from e')
  try:gate('bad','h');raise RuntimeError('bad column accepted')
  except AssertionError:pass
 (B/'b1_guard.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','checks':checks,'forbidden_columns_rejected':7},indent=2)+'\n')

"""Prespecified sensitivity on already frozen confirmation predictions; no new model or selection."""
from pathlib import Path
import duckdb,numpy as np,json,csv,hashlib
B=Path(__file__).parent;P=B.parent;A=P/'confirm_a';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
m=json.loads((B/'pred_manifest_confirm.json').read_text());assert m['status']=='PASS'
r=json.loads((B/'confirmation_result.json').read_text());assert r['prediction_manifest_sha256']==sha(B/'pred_manifest_confirm.json')
files=[str(B/f'pred_confirm_{y}_t4.parquet') for y in (2024,2025)]
for f in files:assert sha(Path(f))==m['files'][Path(f).name]
assert sha(A/'labels.parquet')==r['label_sha256']
c=duckdb.connect();c.execute('set threads=4')
c.execute(f"create view p as select * from read_parquet({files!r})")
c.execute(f"create view l as select * from read_parquet('{A/'labels.parquet'}')")
c.execute("create table eligible as select race_id from l where status='NORMAL' and is_model_target group by race_id having count(*) filter(where finish_position=1)>0")
c.execute("create table j as select p.*,l.finish_position from p join eligible using(race_id) left join l using(runner_id)")
def fetch(q):
 r=c.execute(q);ks=[x[0] for x in r.description];return [dict(zip(ks,x)) for x in r.fetchall()]
sensitivity={}
for model,ref in [('bstar','astar'),('astar','a0'),('bstar','a0'),('bstar','ac0')]:
 q=fetch(f"""with co as(select race_id,race_date,venue,finish_position,row_number() over(partition by race_id order by round(s_{model},12) desc,horse_no) x,row_number() over(partition by race_id order by round(s_{ref},12) desc,horse_no) b from j where s_{model} is not null and s_{ref} is not null), r as(select race_id,race_date,venue,max(case when x=1 and finish_position=1 then 1 else 0 end) xw,max(case when b=1 and finish_position=1 then 1 else 0 end) bw from co group by all) select race_date,venue,count(*) n,sum(xw-bw) delta from r group by all order by 1,2""")
 rng=np.random.default_rng(20261124);nn=np.zeros(2000,dtype=np.int64);dd=np.zeros(2000,dtype=np.int64)
 for y in (2024,2025):
  v=[x for x in q if x['race_date'].year==y];n=np.array([x['n'] for x in v]);d=np.array([x['delta'] for x in v]);ix=rng.integers(0,len(v),(2000,len(v)));nn+=n[ix].sum(axis=1);dd+=d[ix].sum(axis=1)
 sensitivity[f'{model}_vs_{ref}']=[float(x) for x in np.quantile(100*dd/nn,[.025,.975])]
concordance=[]
for n in ['a0','ac0','astar','bstar']:
 concordance.extend([dict(model=n,**r) for r in fetch(f"""select year(a.race_date) yr,count(*) comparable,sum(case when round(a.s_{n},12)=round(b.s_{n},12) then .5 when (a.s_{n}-b.s_{n})*(b.finish_position-a.finish_position)>0 then 1. else 0. end) concordant from j a join j b on a.race_id=b.race_id and a.horse_no<b.horse_no where a.s_{n} is not null and b.s_{n} is not null and a.finish_position is not null and b.finish_position is not null and a.finish_position<>b.finish_position group by 1 order by 1""")])
(B/'confirmation_diagnostics.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','purpose':'prespecified venue-day sensitivity and rank concordance; frozen predictions only, no tuning','venue_day_ci95_pp':sensitivity,'rank_concordance':concordance,'selection_unchanged':True,'confirmation_prediction_sha256':sha(B/'pred_manifest_confirm.json')},indent=2,default=str)+'\n')
print(sensitivity,flush=True)

"""Locked retrospective evaluator. Single preregistered B candidate; Astar fallback and A0/AC0 comparators. No fitting."""
from pathlib import Path
import duckdb,numpy as np,json,hashlib,csv
B=Path(__file__).parent;P=B.parent;A=P/'confirm_a';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
m=json.loads((B/'pred_manifest_confirm.json').read_text());assert m['status']=='PASS' and sha(P/'candidate_config.json')==m['candidate_sha256']
files=[str(B/f'pred_confirm_{y}_t4.parquet') for y in [2024,2025]]
for f in files:assert sha(Path(f))==m['files'][Path(f).name]
c=duckdb.connect();c.execute('set threads=4');c.execute("set memory_limit='1800MB'")
c.execute(f'create view p as select * from read_parquet({files!r})')
im=json.loads((A/'input_manifest.json').read_text());assert sha(A/'labels.parquet')==im['labels_sha256']
c.execute(f"create view l as select * from read_parquet('{A/'labels.parquet'}') where year(race_date) between 2024 and 2025")
c.execute("create table eligible as select race_id from l where status='NORMAL' and is_model_target group by race_id having count(*) filter(where finish_position=1)>0")
c.execute("create table j as select p.*,l.finish_position from p join eligible using(race_id) left join l using(runner_id)")
assert c.execute('select count(*)=count(distinct runner_id) from j').fetchone()[0]
models=['a0','ac0','astar','bstar'];rows=[];segments=[];pairs=[];blocks=[];cis={}
def fetch(sql):
 q=c.execute(sql);fields=[x[0] for x in q.description];return [dict(zip(fields,x)) for x in q.fetchall()]
for n in models:
 sql=f"""with rr as(select race_id,race_date,venue,count(*) runners,count(s_{n}) scored,max(case when r_{n}=1 and finish_position=1 then 1 else 0 end) win,max(case when r_{n}=1 and finish_position between 1 and 3 then 1 else 0 end) top3,max(case when r_{n}<=3 and finish_position=1 then 1 else 0 end) winner3,max(case when r_{n}=1 and finish_position is not null then 1 else 0 end) known,count(*) filter(where finish_position=1) winners,count(*) filter(where r_{n}<=3 and finish_position=1) found from j group by all) """
 agg="count(*) eligible,sum(runners) runners,sum(scored) scored_runners,count(*) filter(where scored>0) scored_races,sum(win) wins,sum(top3) top3,sum(winner3) winner3,sum(known) known_top1,count(*) filter(where scored>=3) complete_top3,sum(winner3) filter(where scored>=3) winner3_complete,sum(winners) winners,sum(found) winner_found"
 rows.extend([dict(model=n,**r) for r in fetch(sql+f"select coalesce(year(race_date),0) yr,{agg} from rr group by grouping sets ((year(race_date)),()) order by 1")])
 segments.extend([dict(model=n,**r) for r in fetch(sql+f"select venue,{agg} from rr group by venue order by venue")])
for n,ref in [('bstar','astar'),('astar','a0'),('bstar','a0'),('bstar','ac0')]:
 sql=f"""with common as(select race_id,race_date,venue,finish_position,row_number() over(partition by race_id order by round(s_{n},12) desc,horse_no) x,row_number() over(partition by race_id order by round(s_{ref},12) desc,horse_no) b from j where s_{n} is not null and s_{ref} is not null), r as(select race_id,race_date,venue,count(*) runners,max(case when x=1 and finish_position=1 then 1 else 0 end) xw,max(case when b=1 and finish_position=1 then 1 else 0 end) bw,max(case when x=1 and finish_position between 1 and 3 then 1 else 0 end) xt,max(case when b=1 and finish_position between 1 and 3 then 1 else 0 end) bt,max(case when x<=3 and finish_position=1 then 1 else 0 end) xh,max(case when b<=3 and finish_position=1 then 1 else 0 end) bh from common group by all) """
 agg="count(*) races,sum(runners) common_runners,sum(xw) model_win,sum(bw) ref_win,sum(xt) model_top3,sum(bt) ref_top3,sum(xh) model_winner3,sum(bh) ref_winner3"
 pairs.extend([dict(model=n,ref=ref,**r) for r in fetch(sql+f"select coalesce(year(race_date),0) yr,{agg} from r group by grouping sets ((year(race_date)),()) order by 1")])
 for r in fetch(sql+"select venue,"+agg+" from r group by venue order by venue"):
  segments.append(dict(model=n,ref=ref,**r))
 d=fetch(sql+"select race_date,count(*) n,sum(xw-bw) delta from r group by race_date order by race_date")
 for r in d:blocks.append(dict(model=n,ref=ref,**r))
 rng=np.random.default_rng(20261124);nn=np.zeros(2000,dtype=np.int64);dd=np.zeros(2000,dtype=np.int64)
 for y in [2024,2025]:
  q=[r for r in d if r['race_date'].year==y];a=np.array([r['n'] for r in q]);b=np.array([r['delta'] for r in q]);ix=rng.integers(0,len(q),(2000,len(q)));nn+=a[ix].sum(axis=1);dd+=b[ix].sum(axis=1)
 cis[f'{n}_vs_{ref}']=[float(x) for x in np.quantile(100*dd/nn,[.025,.975])]
def save(n,rs):
 keys=list(dict.fromkeys(k for r in rs for k in r))
 with open(B/n,'w') as f:
  w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=keys);w.writeheader();w.writerows(rs)
save('metrics_confirm.csv',rows);save('segments_confirm.csv',segments);save('pairs_confirm.csv',pairs);save('blocks_confirm.csv',blocks)
def native(n):return next(r for r in rows if r['model']==n and r['yr']==0)
def pair(n,ref):return next(r for r in pairs if r['model']==n and r['ref']==ref and r['yr']==0)
def gate(n,ref):
 p=pair(n,ref);a,b=native(n),native(ref);den=p['races'];d=100*(p['model_win']-p['ref_win'])/den
 sec=[100*(p[x]-p[y])/den for x,y in [('model_top3','ref_top3'),('model_winner3','ref_winner3')]]
 cov_r=100*(a['scored_races']-b['scored_races'])/a['eligible'];cov_u=100*(a['scored_runners']-b['scored_runners'])/a['runners']
 venue_flags=[r['venue'] for r in segments if r.get('ref')==ref and r['model']==n and r['races']>=500 and 100*(r['model_win']-r['ref_win'])/r['races']<-2]
 c0=cis[f'{n}_vs_{ref}']
 return {'delta_pp':d,'ci95_pp':c0,'secondary_delta_pp':sec,'race_coverage_delta_pp':cov_r,'runner_coverage_delta_pp':cov_u,'full_win_delta':a['wins']-b['wins'],'venue_review':venue_flags,'pass':d>=.3 and c0[0]>0 and min(sec)>=-.5 and cov_r>=-.5 and cov_u>=-1 and a['wins']>=b['wins']}
g=gate('bstar','astar');g0=gate('astar','a0');g1=gate('bstar','a0')
# No model retuning. Use simple fallback only if it passes its predeclared A0 gate.
selected='P8-Bstar-r1' if g['pass'] and g1['pass'] else ('P8-Astar-r1' if g0['pass'] else 'P8-A0')
result={'status':'LOCKED_CONFIRMATION_EVALUATED_ONCE','candidate_sha256':sha(P/'candidate_config.json'),'prediction_manifest_sha256':sha(B/'pred_manifest_confirm.json'),'label_sha256':sha(A/'labels.parquet'),'native':[r for r in rows if r['yr']==0],'pairs':[r for r in pairs if r['yr']==0],'gates':{'bstar_vs_astar':g,'astar_vs_a0':g0,'bstar_vs_a0':g1},'selected_for_p9':selected,'production_approved':False,'2026_used':False,'confirmation_opened':True,'note':'No tuning after opening. 2024–25 retrospective, not independent blind holdout; predeclared simpler fallback.'}
(B/'confirmation_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),flush=True)

"""Confirmation parity and evaluator isolation test. Label file intentionally absent then poisoned in separate sandbox."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,duckdb,shutil
B=Path(__file__).parent;P=B.parent;A=P/'confirm_a';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(A/'enriched_t1.parquet')==sha(A/'enriched_t4.parquet')
c=duckdb.connect()
old=Path('/mnt/data/P8A_20261124/enriched_t4.parquet');new=A/'enriched_t4.parquet'
# compare prefix exact keys/nulls/floats to earlier frozen history reference
cols=c.execute(f"describe select * from read_parquet('{old}')").fetchall()
cmp=[f'((a.{k} is null)<>(b.{k} is null) or abs(a.{k}-b.{k})>1e-12)' if typ=='DOUBLE' else f'a.{k} is distinct from b.{k}' for k,typ,*_ in cols]
diff=c.execute(f"""select count(*) from read_parquet('{old}') a full join (select * from read_parquet('{new}') where year(race_date)<=2023) b using(runner_id) where a.runner_id is null or b.runner_id is null or """+' or '.join(cmp)).fetchone()[0];assert diff==0,diff
rows=[];files={}
for y in [2024,2025]:
 p=B/f'pred_confirm_{y}_t4.parquet';q=B/f'pred_confirm_{y}_t1.parquet'
 assert sha(p)==sha(q);n,u=c.execute(f"select count(*),count(distinct runner_id) from read_parquet('{p}')").fetchone();assert n==u
 files[p.name]=files[q.name]=sha(p);rows.append({'year':y,'rows':n,'byte_parity':True})
# Copy only score inputs into isolated temporary directory. Run with no labels, then deliberately invalid label bytes.
S=P/'confirmation_score_isolation';S.mkdir(exist_ok=True);sa=S/'confirm_a';sb=S/'confirm_b';sa.mkdir(exist_ok=True);sb.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def link(src,dst):
 if not dst.exists():os.link(src,dst)
for n in ['confirmation_gate.json','candidate_config.json','b1_2023_t4.parquet']:link(P/n,S/n)
for n in ['pred_manifest_a34val.json','feature_manifest.json','a34_feature_manifest.json']+[f'{name}_{y}_t4.parquet' for name in ['pred_a34val','features'] for y in [2024,2025]]:link(A/n,sa/n)
for n in ['b1_guard.json','score.py']+[f'b1_{y}_t{th}.parquet' for y in [2023,2024,2025] for th in (1,4)]:link(B/n,sb/n)
assert not (sa/'labels.parquet').exists()
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(sb/'score.py'),'4'],check=True)
before={y:sha(sb/f'pred_confirm_{y}_t4.parquet') for y in (2024,2025)}
(sa/'labels.parquet').write_bytes(b'poisoned evaluator labels; invalid parquet; must not be read')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(sb/'score.py'),'4'],check=True)
assert before=={y:sha(sb/f'pred_confirm_{y}_t4.parquet') for y in (2024,2025)}
assert all(before[y]==files[f'pred_confirm_{y}_t4.parquet'] for y in before)
(B/'pred_manifest_confirm.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','files':files,'checks':rows,'reference_prefix_diff':diff,'score_without_labels_and_poisoned_labels':'PASS','candidate_sha256':sha(P/'candidate_config.json'),'label_opened':False},indent=2)+'\n')
print('confirmation gate PASS',rows,flush=True)

sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
gate=json.loads((P/'confirmation_gate.json').read_text());assert sha(P/'candidate_config.json')==gate['candidate_sha256'] and gate['status']=='FROZEN_BEFORE_CONFIRMATION'

for n in ['entry','history']:assert sha(A/(n+'.parquet'))==im[n+'_sha256']
c=duckdb.connect();c.execute('set threads=4')
r=[str(C/f'pre/race/race_year={y}/data.parquet') for y in range(2016,2026)]
u=[str(C/f'pre/runner/race_year={y}/data.parquet') for y in range(2016,2026)]

c.execute(f"create view uu as select runner_id,gate from read_parquet({u!r})")
band="case when distance_m<=1000 then 1 when distance_m<=1400 then 2 when distance_m<=1700 then 3 when distance_m<=2000 then 4 else 5 end"
for n in ['entry','history']:
 cols='runner_id,race_id,race_date,venue,horse_key,horse_no,surface,distance_m,field_size,ambiguous,race_name,conditions'
 cols+=',perf,finish_time_seconds,final_3f_seconds,finish_position' if n=='history' else ''

 # Prior periods must be identical to previously frozen inputs; compare row values via EXCEPT ALL.
 p=P/(n+'.parquet')
 diff=c.execute(f"select count(*) from ((select * from {n} where year(race_date)<=2023 except all select * from read_parquet('{p}')) union all (select * from read_parquet('{p}') except all select * from {n} where year(race_date)<=2023))").fetchone()[0];assert diff==0
 c.execute(f"copy (select * from {n} order by runner_id) to '{B/(n+'.parquet')}' (format parquet,compression zstd)")
(B/'input_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','entry_sha256':sha(B/'entry.parquet'),'history_sha256':sha(B/'history.parquet'),'candidate_sha256':gate['candidate_sha256'],'prefix_input_parity':'PASS'},indent=2)+'\n')

"""Confirmation Freeze builder. No labels read. Only approved frozen candidate and derived A/B features."""
import duckdb,json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
B=Path(__file__).parent;P=B.parent;A=P/'confirm_a';th=int(sys.argv[1]);c=duckdb.connect();c.execute(f'set threads={th}');c.execute("set memory_limit='1500MB'")
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
gate=json.loads((P/'confirmation_gate.json').read_text());assert sha(P/'candidate_config.json')==gate['candidate_sha256']
cfg=json.loads((P/'candidate_config.json').read_text());assert cfg['terms']==['b1_venue180_k3_w25']
assert json.loads((B/'b1_guard.json').read_text())['status']=='PASS'
# Verify old prefix and confirmation features.
assert sha(B/'b1_2023_t1.parquet')==sha(B/'b1_2023_t4.parquet')==sha(P/'b1_2023_t4.parquet')
mf=json.loads((A/'pred_manifest_a34val.json').read_text());fm=json.loads((A/'feature_manifest.json').read_text());am=json.loads((A/'a34_feature_manifest.json').read_text())
assert all(x['status']=='PASS' for x in (mf,fm,am))
# Historical reference prefix from 2017–23 must be unchanged, with exact nonfloats / <=1e-12 floats.
for y in [2024,2025]:
 p=A/f'pred_a34val_{y}_t{th}.parquet';f=A/f'features_{y}_t{th}.parquet';g=B/f'b1_{y}_t{th}.parquet'
 assert sha(p)==mf['files'][p.name] and sha(f)==fm['files'][f.name]
 assert sha(B/f'b1_{y}_t1.parquet')==sha(B/f'b1_{y}_t4.parquet')
 for n,q in [('p',p),('f',f),('g',g)]:c.execute(f"create or replace view {n} as select * from read_parquet('{q}')")
 assert not set(x[0] for n in ['p','f','g'] for x in c.execute('describe '+n).fetchall()) & {'finish_position','status','popularity','payout_yen','track_condition','body_weight_kg','overall_record_raw'}
 e=cfg['definitions'][cfg['terms'][0]]
 c.execute(f"""create or replace table s as select p.runner_id,p.race_id,p.race_date,p.venue,p.horse_no,p.field_size,p.ambiguous,p.n_hl60,g.distance_m,g.last_distance,g.last_same_venue,p.s_a0,p.s_one_run_combined s_astar,p.r_a0 a0_rank,p.r_one_run_combined astar_rank,case when p.s_a0 is not null then p.s_a0+coalesce(.25*f.cn/(f.cn+3.)*(f.course-f.a0),0) end s_ac0,case when p.s_one_run_combined is not null then p.s_one_run_combined+({e}) end s_bstar from p join f using(runner_id) join g using(runner_id)""".replace('when n_hl60>=2','when p.n_hl60>=2'))
 # Column n180, n_venue180, d_venue180 exist only in g.
 assert c.execute('select count(*) from s').fetchone()==c.execute('select count(*) from p').fetchone()
 models=['a0','ac0','astar','bstar'];assert c.execute('select count(*) from s where '+' or '.join(f'(s_{n} is not null and not isfinite(s_{n}))' for n in models)).fetchone()[0]==0
 ranks=','.join(f'case when s_{n} is not null then row_number() over(partition by race_id order by round(s_{n},12) desc nulls last,horse_no asc) end r_{n}' for n in models)
 o=B/f'pred_confirm_{y}_t{th}.parquet';c.execute(f"copy (select *,{ranks},case when s_astar is not null then 'SCORED' when ambiguous then 'AMBIGUOUS_IDENTITY' else 'INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY' end reason_astar from s order by runner_id) to '{o}' (format parquet,compression zstd)")
 assert c.execute(f"select count(*) from read_parquet('{o}') where r_a0 is distinct from a0_rank or r_astar is distinct from astar_rank or (s_bstar is null)<>(s_astar is null)").fetchone()[0]==0
 print('confirmation freeze',y,th,sha(o),flush=True)
